name: Autotile
description: A game map drawn with corner-matched tiles: rounded islands of land in open water, with hills rising inside them, the coastlines running smoothly from tile to tile.

code.style: --rule: ( --gate: @r(1); --s: @pd(@r(0, 50)); --ix: @x; --iy: @y; --mx: @X; --my: @Y; --fa: $(round((sin(ix*1.13 + iy*0.47 + s - 1.6) + sin(iy*1.05 - ix*0.41 + 1.7*s - 0.64) + 0.7*sin((ix - iy)*0.83 + 2.3*s))*10000)/10000); --fb: $(round((sin(ix*1.13 + iy*0.47 + s - 0.47) + sin(iy*1.05 - ix*0.41 + 1.7*s - 1.05) + 0.7*sin((ix - iy)*0.83 + 2.3*s + 0.83))*10000)/10000); --fc: $(round((sin(ix*1.13 + iy*0.47 + s) + sin(iy*1.05 - ix*0.41 + 1.7*s) + 0.7*sin((ix - iy)*0.83 + 2.3*s))*10000)/10000); --fd: $(round((sin(ix*1.13 + iy*0.47 + s - 1.13) + sin(iy*1.05 - ix*0.41 + 1.7*s + 0.41) + 0.7*sin((ix - iy)*0.83 + 2.3*s - 0.83))*10000)/10000); --lk: $(8*(fa >= 0.15) + 4*(fb >= 0.15) + 2*(fc >= 0.15) + (fd >= 0.15)); --hk: $(8*(fa >= 1.05) + 4*(fb >= 1.05) + 2*(fc >= 1.05) + (fd >= 1.05)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-mask: @var(--am$(lk)); mask: @var(--am$(lk)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: @var(--am$(hk)); mask: @var(--am$(hk)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --am0: linear-gradient(transparent, transparent); --am1: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --am2: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --am3: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(transparent 50%, #000 50%); --am4: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --am5: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --am6: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 50%, #000 50%); --am7: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 50%, #000 50%), linear-gradient(transparent 50%, #000 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 50%, #000 50%); --am8: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --am9: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 50%, transparent 50%); --am10: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --am11: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(transparent 50%, #000 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, transparent 50%, #000 50%); --am12: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(#000 0 50%, transparent 50%); --am13: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(#000 0 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); --am14: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(#000 0 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 50%, #000 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); --am15: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(#000 0 50%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 50%, #000 50%), linear-gradient(transparent 50%, #000 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 50%, transparent 50%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
